name: EPIC 205643699
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 8.3 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 205643699 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.264685 (16th-84th percentiles 7.951246-8.651666), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 1,031 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.95 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,847 K at its surface.
